name: Storage in depleted oil and gas fields
principle: CO2 is injected into depleted gas or oil reservoirs, which have proven seals and known capacity. Porthos in the Netherlands will inject 2.5 Mtpa at about 3 km depth into depleted fields P18-2, P18-4 and P18-6 about 20 km off the coast. PETRONAS Kasawari CCS will reinject 3.3 Mtpa into the depleted M1 field offshore Sarawak.

performance.basis: 37 Mt over 15 years; injection pressure up to 130 bar

source.note: Oil & Gas Journal, PETRONAS takes FID for offshore Malaysia CCS
Oil & Gas Journal, PETRONAS takes FID for offshore Malaysia CCS

limitations: Legacy wells are leakage paths (see well integrity card)
